title: Zuljanah
body:
zuljanah ay zuljanah
mere baba ke zuljanah
<<DIVIDER>>
kehti thi ye sakina zakhmi hai tu kyun itna
maqtal mein kya hua bata zuljanah
mere baba ke zuljanah...
<<DIVIDER>>
itna bata de kyun ghabraya hai tu
kyun mere baba ko chod aaya hai tu
tere qadmon ki jab awaaz aayi
mai ye samjhi baba ko laaya hai tu
na ghazi hai na bhaiya haye baba ka laasha
maqtal se kaun laayega zuljanah
mere baba ke zuljanah...
<<DIVIDER>>
tere qadmon mein ye gir kar kaha tha
na le jaa baba ko mere na le jaa
tanha baba ko jo jaane diya tha
teri wafa pe tha mujhko bharosa
tujhko ghazi ki qasam rakhle wafa ka bharam
tanha kyun lauta hai bata
mere baba ke zuljanah...
<<DIVIDER>>
ruqsat baba ki na bhooli sakina
aakhri baar jo soyi sakina
aa kar ye khwaab mein dadi pukari
bhejo hussain ko bali sakina
tab se bichdi hoo dekho jaane na deti un ko
gar mujhse kehti na zahra zuljanah
mere baba ke zuljanah...
<<DIVIDER>>
gham kitne toote ghareebul watan par
naize chale hai kya un ke badan par
sar to utha teri aankhon mein dekhun
kya kya sitam huwe shaahe zaman par
aansu rawan hai tere baba kahan hai mere
kyun hai khamosh ye bata zuljanah
mere baba ke zuljanah...
<<DIVIDER>>
yeh zehra jaane ya allah jaane
mere baba thay jaane kab se pyase
aankhein tumhari mujhse keh rahi hai
maqtal se tum bhi ho pyase hi laute
mujhko yaqeen hai mere baba ne tum se pehle
pani kahan piya hoga zuljanah
mere baba ke zuljanah...
<<DIVIDER>>
mujhko taapon ki jo aati hai sada
wehshat se phat'ta hai kaleja mera
charon taraf hai zaalimon ka pehra
tanha hai ran mein mere pyase baba
laasha pamaal na ho jaake bachale unko
mai bhi mar jaungi warna zuljanah
mere baba ke zuljanah...
<<DIVIDER>>
loote na qaimon ko aa kar sitamgar
haye chin jaaye na phupiyon ki chadar
kis ko pukarungi itna bata de
zaalim jab khaychega kaano se gohar
kaun hai ab hamara koi nahi sahara
lut jayega mera kunba zuljanah
mere baba ke zuljanah...
<<DIVIDER>>
kehti hai karbala darwaish o zeeshan
rota raha sar jhukaye zuljanah
kaise sakina ke baba ko laaye
chaane lagi hai ab shaam e ghariban
rakh ke qadmon mein sar ko gir gaya khaak par wo
sun kar sakina ka nauha zuljanah
mere baba ke zuljanah...
author: Zeeshan Abidi
